answer: The strongest cheap check I know is signed paramedic registration with health regulator attestation. It demands a registration the health regulator renews against practice hours and CPD, and the trellis is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The basalt is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk. The comet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
